services.name: Pickleball Clinics
services.desc: Whether you're brand new to the game or already smashing winners, our Pickleball Clinics at Big City Pickle West Loop are designed to help you elevate your game and have fun doing it. Master the fundamentals Improve strategy, footwork & technique Learn pro tips to sharpen your skills Connect with a fun, welcoming pickleball community We’ve got small-group pickleball sessions, perfect for beginners looking to build confidence and intermediates looking to sharpen their skills. Classes are capped for maximum coaching time, so snag your spot early! BEGINNERS Play Session (Beginner-to-2.5) Play Session (Beginner-to-Intermediate 2.5-3.0) INTERMEDIATE Play Session (Intermediate 3.0+) Play Session
